approvals.name: interprocess
approvals.purpose: Provide synchronous cross-platform local IPC primitives for kernuxd using Unix-domain sockets on Unix and local named pipes on Windows, with default features disabled.

approvals.name: serde
approvals.purpose: Serialize and deserialize generated Kernux Runtime Protocol Rust contracts from the authoritative JSON Schema.

approvals.name: serde_json
approvals.purpose: Consume shared JSON conformance fixtures in Rust tests and encode/decode bounded kernuxd local control frames at runtime.

approvals.name: oxfmt
approvals.purpose: Pinned JavaScript and TypeScript formatting for repository checks.

approvals.name: oxlint
approvals.purpose: Pinned JavaScript and TypeScript linting for repository checks.

approvals.name: typescript
approvals.purpose: Pinned strict TypeScript compiler for repository and generated-contract checks.

approvals.name: ed25519-dalek
approvals.purpose: Provide the exact Ed25519 signing/verifying primitive for bounded local installation identity key lifecycle and session-binding signatures, with default features disabled and only zeroization support enabled.

approvals.name: getrandom
approvals.purpose: Obtain operating-system randomness for local installation IDs, instance IDs, and Ed25519 seed generation without adding a general RNG framework.

approvals.name: zeroize
approvals.purpose: Provide explicit zeroization for bounded local recovery-seed secret wrappers and Ed25519 secret material handling.
